description: a bar of radius 1.43 on z less a ball of radius 2 centred (0.39, 0.78, 1.48): the ball's section with the bar's wall leaves the top cap where the two walls meet at about 5°. S5 traces the wall pair again, clipped to the two faces' own boxes rather than to the boolean's region; with each fit held to a quarter tolerance of both surfaces, two fits of the one grazing section lay 1.06e-7 apart across it, where the edge's tolerance is 1e-7, and a sample of the checker's curve was on no shared edge and interior to both faces. A fit held to the exact branch at the same parameter is within a quarter tolerance of it, so two fits are within half of each other whatever the angle (ADR-0022, plans/c3-tolerance-apart step 5b). Found at a random pose in two hundred (plans/c3-conic-hits step 5). The area tolerance is stated at 1e-7 because the oracle's own solid is the far side here: Open CASCADE leaves a section edge of it at a tolerance of 2.84e-6, and its area 33.1158443109 — the same to 1e-14 at an integration precision of 1e-9 and 1e-12 — is 3.1e-8 relative from the 33.1158453338 Arris converges to, to 1e-10, as the model tolerance goes from 1e-7 to 1e-10; on the STEP Arris writes, Open CASCADE measures Arris's own area to 1e-14. The volume, centroid and inertia hold at the defaults
